in_greek.name: Λοράντ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Λοράντ προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη 'laurus', που σημαίνει δάφνη, ένα σύμβολο τιμής και δόξας. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, η δάφνη συνδέεται με τον Απόλλωνα και συμβολίζει τη νίκη και την αριστεία.

in_latin.name: Laurent
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Laurent is derived from the Latin word 'laurus', meaning laurel tree, a symbol of honor and glory in ancient Roman culture. The laurel wreath was awarded to victors and heroes, signifying achievement and prestige.

in_english.name: Laurent
in_english.long_meaning: The name Laurent originates from the Latin 'laurus', meaning laurel tree, which symbolizes honor, glory, and achievement. In Christian tradition, the laurel tree represents victory over adversity and is associated with martyrdom and sainthood. Historically, the name Laurent has been used in various Christian cultures, signifying strength, courage, and devotion.

saint_reference.note: Saint Laurent of Rome was a deacon and martyr in the early Christian Church, known for his generosity and devotion to the poor.

data.cultural_impact: The name Laurent is of Latin origin and brings with it a rich cultural history. data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Laurent is associated with St. Lawrence, a deacon and martyr who is celebrated for his heroic faith. He is said to have distributed the church's treasury to the poor, and then, when ordered to hand it over to the emperor, he presented the poor instead. His faith and charitable giving are celebrated in the name and are a powerful reminder of the importance of generosity, faith, and service to others.
